shortDescription: MPESB Group 1 Sub Group 2 Result 2026 is out. Check score/merit at esb.mp.gov.in.
content:
Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has declared the Group 1 Sub Group 2 Result 2026.

Candidates can check their result on the official MPESB portal using application credentials or by downloading the result PDF.
